hero.description: The group represents Ségou. Eight traditional female singers clad in white are standing behind a microphone. A man is carrying a hugekettle drum, three other men with tall caps are handling smaller drums. Two masked and disguised dancers, one as a donkey in checkered clothes. A calabash drum, a balafon, a long flute wielded by a man in yellow. A line of spectators at the edge of the football field.

A crowd of young spectators is watching all of them on a sandy football field with a goal. A balafon (on the right) and drums (on the left), two loudspeakers on high.

gallery.description: The group represents Tominian. A man in white at the left is the lead singer while a line of five male traditional dancers is standing in a special outfit with caps and fringes in the center of a sandy football field with a goal and a crowd of young male spectators, many in colourful football shirts. A balafon on the sand and loudspeakers on high. Two men in white, one with a Fulani hat. Musical instruments. Fly-whisks.

gallery.description: The group represents Ségou. Three men wearing special black-and-white caps wielding fly-whisks are dancing to the music of five drummers, one with a large kettle drum, and two balafon players. Two disguised dancers, one as a donkey with a tail, the other in yellow garb, are standing to the right. A group of traditional female singers clad in white are joining in. Many male spectators in coloured football shirts are attending from the edge of a sandy football field with a goal.

gallery.description: The group represents Tominian. Five male traditional dancers in special clothes and caps with fringes are dancing to the music of two balafon (fifteen-tone xylophones) players in front of them on a sandy football field with many young male attendees and a football goal. Eight women are clapping near the five dancers who are waving with fly-whisks in their hands.

gallery.description: The group represents Tominian. Five male traditional line dancers in special garb with fly-whisks are being photographed by a kneeling young man at a football field. A balafon (xylophone) player and a man in a Fulani hat with a group of clapping women. Many onlookers are attending from the edge of the field. Loudspeakers. A man in western khaki clothes with a khaki hat is wearing dark sunglasses.
